description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 7215/APP/2020/2901 (as amended), dated 03-12-20 (Request for approval of Plans and specifications under condition imposed by Schedule 17 to the High Speed Rail (London - West Midlands) Act 2017 relating to a head house (South Ruislip Vent Shaft Head House) compound, which includes the vent shaft headhouse building, the fan room building, two ventilation stacks, road vehicle parking, an Autotransformer Station, earthworks for retaining walls and associated fencing and artificial lighting units) to allow for the provision of additional compound security fencing, minor earthworks near this additional fence to direct surface water to the drainage retention basin, and the relocation of a lighting column.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: Only amendments which are subject to Schedule 17 approval are considered under this application for non-material changes to the design of the South Ruislip Vent Shaft site. The amendments sought for approval relate to:
As shown on the following submitted plans:
1MC04-SCJ_SDH-LS-DGA-SS05_SL06-431002 - Rev C04 (Landscape GA Plan - Hard Landscape and Earthworks)
1MC04-SCJ_SDH-LS-DGA-SS05_SL06-431003 - Rev C04 (Landscape GA Plan Indicative Mitigation)
